### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **140** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `9c8fcc09f4382786ba45bee9448af58a380da923` — the merge of head `ee37bc3c6d4af39c56c2c04ab4d289f369424f23` into base `6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 9c8fcc09f4382786ba45bee9448af58a380da923 && git checkout 9c8fcc09f4382786ba45bee9448af58a380da923
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703 ee37bc3c6d4af39c56c2c04ab4d289f369424f23 && git checkout -B drift-repro 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703 && git merge --no-ff ee37bc3c6d4af39c56c2c04ab4d289f369424f23

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6662e3f590e9790a28f598d3eb6f665e46f10703
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ee37bc3c6d4af39c56c2c04ab4d289f369424f23`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card #23000's body and its four comments (triage `6121428844`, claim `6130629644`, os-dev-report `6132129290`, seat ACCEPT `6132166858`); PR #23095's body, its file list (3 files) and the net diff against `main` at the merge-base (`main at 8c1077615`, +8/−3); the 43 check-runs on the head. Everything below was read from git objects (the objectstack head, and objectui at the pin `objectui@7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21`, which `.objectui-sha` names at both the head and `origin/main`). Nothing was checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Accept set of `AppBrandingSchema.logo` — unchanged, right.** The diff replaces only the `.describe()` argument at `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:955`; the chain stays `z.string().optional()` inside the same `strictObject`. No refusal of a non-square value was added, exactly as triage `6121428844` directs: a URL string carries no ratio, and a refusal would be a new validation gate, which defaults to no.
2. **Published description text of `branding.logo` — changed, right.** The new text carries the card's three facts verbatim ("1:1 square app icon, SVG preferred, at least 64 px") plus the ruling's one-asset consequence ("the app's one logo asset — each surface scales it to the size it needs, and there is no second size or wordmark slot"). It ships in `@objectstack/spec`'s dist as Zod metadata (and in any JSON Schema a consumer derives at runtime), so it is a public-surface text change and nothing more; no `.d.ts` surface moves, since `.describe()` does not reach types.
3. **Generated reference `content/docs/references/ui/app.mdx`, two rows (the `App.branding` nested shape at L97 and `AppBranding` at L314) — right and complete.** Stale-artifact test at the head: a grep for the sibling description "Primary theme color hex code" hits only `app.zod.ts` and `app.mdx`, so no other generated shard (json-schema manifest, llms, skills) carries descriptions and none can be stale; a grep for the old text "Custom logo URL for this app" finds only the three new-text carriers. The dev's "`check:docs` the only stale artifact" claim holds, and `Build Docs` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are green on the head.
4. **"Each surface scales it to the size it needs" — backed at the pin, right** (Prime Directive #10 corollary: declared must equal delivered). At `objectui@7578323a544e31d574804ae931b595e8f9f92c21`, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppMark.tsx` reads `app.branding.logo` and draws it as one `img` with `object-contain` at 22 px (`sm`: top-bar pill and switcher rows) and 26 px (`md`: phone drawer); `AppSwitcher.tsx` and `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` route through it, and `layout/AppSchemaRenderer.tsx:442` and `runner/LayoutRenderer.tsx:156` also read `branding.logo`. No second asset field and no wordmark slot exist at the pin. The description names no px and no renderer — right: the spec does not bind renderer sizes (#2), and the sentence stays true for a surface that does not draw the key.
5. **Alias table (`logourl` to `logo`, app.zod.ts:947) and the app-level `logo` near-miss that points at `branding` (L1415) — untouched, right.** Both still resolve to the one key whose description changed; no new alias, no `??` fallback, no ADR-0087 entry is owed (#12).
6. **Scope and tier — right.** The diff is exactly the claimed file surface (the describe, the generated artifact `check:generated` names, one changeset). No governed path on the file list (none of `docs/adr`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `.claude`, `skills`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`); head repo equals base repo, so not a fork proposal (#14). `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green. This record is the compensating control the claim named for the `packages/spec/src/**` path limb, not a Tier S lift.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/23000-branding-logo-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` **`patch` — right.** The describe text ships in a released package's dist, so `skip-changeset` would be wrong (that label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package); no new accept, no widening, no removal or rename, so `minor` is not owed and no migration text or ADR-0087 disposition marker applies. The changeset body was checked sentence by sentence against the diff: "the key stays an optional string", "the accept set is byte-identical", "a non-square value is not refused" each match what the diff publishes.
- **`Clause-②: no` — right and well-formed.** At line start in the PR body (its third line), no arm. `no` with no arm is the only shape a text-only diff can carry: `yes` would owe at least `minor`, `(narrowing)` would be BREAKING, `no (widening)` is malformed. It matches the claim `6130629644`.
- `Check Changeset` on the head: one run success, a second run in_progress at read time.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty** — nothing to answer.
- **Deviation 1** (the describe names no console and no px figure, where the dispatch suggested "rendered by the console at the sizes each surface needs") — **accepted.** Sizes are renderer behaviour that moves without the spec; the card's ask was the three facts, and they are carried verbatim.
- **Deviations 2–6** (merge of `origin/main` through `os-regen-merge.sh` with no regeneration owed; two prerequisite whole-repo builds; zero label writes; the model-free trailer pair; `Fixes` and `Clause-②` placement) — **process notes, none touches the contract.** Labels have since been applied by Auto Label (`documentation`, `size/s`, `tooling`, `needs:contract-review`, `protocol:ui`). `main` moving three commits past the merge-base is the queue's rebuild, not this record's concern; none touched the three files.
- **OOS-1** (`packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, `app.branding.children.logo` reads `planned`, "AUTHORED, RENDERED BY NOTHING THAT SHIPS", measured at the older pin f8a9d0fb) — **noted-not-filed holds under #10, with a rider.** Verified stale at the head: the row's own instruction reads "Flip to `live` citing that reader at the pin that carries it", and `AppMark.tsx` is that reader at the current pin. It is not a reproducible defect, a contract violation or a metadata-authoring trap: the ledger errs toward UNDERSTATING a live key, the row carries its own ENFORCE direction and carrier id (so no retirement act can be misled by it), and authors never read it (no `authorWarn`). It sits outside the claimed file surface, and #10 says never expand scope. **Escalated to the seat as an owed one-row flip:** it rides the next PR that touches `liveness/app.json` or bumps `.objectui-sha`, citing `AppMark.tsx` at the pin above.
- **OOS-2** (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.form.ts:94` helpText "Primary/secondary colors, logo, theme" on the Branding composite, while the block has `primaryColor`, `accentColor`, `logo`, `favicon`) — **noted-not-filed holds.** Verified at the head (L91 "Theme colors and logo." and L94). Misleading Studio copy, not a silent trap: `secondaryColor` and `theme` are refused loudly by the strict shape (`theme` even resolves to `primaryColor` through the alias table), it was not reproduced in a running Studio, and a fix regenerates the nine i18n bundles, so it is not a bounded in-place edit. Carrier: the next PR that touches `app.form.ts`.

Check-runs on the head, 43 read at 2026-10-12T20:41Z: 24 success, 8 skipped (opt-in and matrix placeholders), 11 in_progress — `Check Changeset` (second run), `Test Core` 1–6, `Build Core`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Type Check · consumer gates` — and 0 failure. The seat reads CI convergence separately; this verdict is about the contract.
